verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch is driven programmatically through documented interfaces. The evidence shows a REST API reference (the RRF link points to /reference/elasticsearch/rest-apis), Query DSL and ES|QL docs, and the inference API. It also has official language clients with a forward-compatibility policy, agent-oriented skills, and an official MCP server. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the guessed marketing-site paths, which weakens machine-readable discovery but does not contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at a discoverable location, a direct excerpt from the REST API reference itself, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
